apps.name: K3 Browser
apps.subtitle: Latest-iOS Magnetic Capsule browser
apps.localizedDescription: Native SwiftUI + WKWebView operator browser for the latest iOS generation. v0.7 replaces the page-resizing Agent Shelf with a page-first Magnetic Capsule: a movable Agent Ball morphs into compose, active-status, and durable result surfaces without resizing the webpage. Blocking approval authority, Mission Control, redaction, immutable run identity, exact navigation settlement, and engagement scope enforcement remain intact.
apps.versionDescription: Magnetic Capsule UI: latest-iOS-only baseline, full-size WKWebView workspace, collapsed Agent Ball, one keyboard-safe composer, active Stop/status peek, durable result peek, modern Mission Control sheet, 320pt/AX layout adaptation, VoiceOver actions, and Reduce Motion crossfade.
